marketTone: The official 30-year yield rose to 5.64% and the 10-year to 5.29%, while the 2-year eased to 4.88%. August core PCE was 3.0% on the year and second-quarter GDP was revised up to 2.2%. Brent settled at 103.53 after US-Iran talks stayed stuck on sequencing. Shanghai's last pre-holiday close was 3,842.19, up 0.31%, as the first-home subsidy starts today and manufacturing PMI printed 50.1%.

ADP: private employment increased by 90,000 in September. August was revised to 36,000 from 38,000.

themeCards.title: The official 30-year yield rose to 5.64%
themeCards.fact: US Treasury: the official 30 September curve printed 4.88% on the 2-year, 5.09% on the 5-year, 5.29% on the 10-year, and 5.64% on the 30-year, after 4.89%, 5.06%, 5.26%, and 5.59% on 29 September. BEA: August PCE rose 0.3% on the month and 3.4% on the year, core PCE rose 0.2% and 3.0%, and second-quarter real GDP was revised to 2.2% from 1.5%. ADP: private employment rose by 90,000 in September, and August was revised to 36,000 from 38,000.
themeCards.mechanism: The long end rose again while the 2-year eased, and a cooler monthly inflation print did not stop it. CICC (24 August): a higher long-end US yield reaches shares through cross-border flows and risk mood, and the link is uneven. USTs, US equities, and the dollar carry the higher 30-year yield. The theme changes if the official 30-year reprints at or below 5.59%.

themeCards.title: Brent settled at 103.53 as talks stayed stuck on sequencing
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: November Brent settled up 0.92% at 103.53, and November WTI settled up 1.16% at 90.42.
themeCards.mechanism: The settle rose while US-Iran talks stayed stuck on the order of steps, so the geopolitics bid returned after the prior drop. CICC (21 September): with inventories lower than before, the oil price can still swing widely. Oil carries the 103.53 close. The theme changes if a later Brent settle reprints at or below 103.53.
themeCards.invalidator: A later Brent settle at or below 103.53.

themeCards.title: The first-home subsidy starts with no application step
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: Shanghai closed at 3,842.19, up 0.31%, on 30 September. 第一财经: from 1 October the large state banks apply the first-home subsidy without a separate application.

factSources.label: 第一财经 房贷贴息免申即享
华尔街见闻 六大行贴息

themeCards.mechanism: The subsidy starts today and the large banks removed the application step, so the payment cut is now an operating rule. CICC (30 September): the mortgage subsidy helps payment ability and local price expectations in some cities, and does less in the largest cities. A-shares carry that rule into the holiday at the 3,842.19 close. The theme changes if the banks drop the no-application rule.
themeCards.trigger: The large banks keep deducting the subsidy in the monthly payment.
themeCards.invalidator: The banks drop the no-application rule.

themeCards.title: Official manufacturing PMI is back above 50
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: September manufacturing PMI was 50.1% and non-manufacturing PMI was 50.2%. Production was 51.7% and new orders were 50.5%.
themeCards.mechanism: Production at 51.7% and new orders at 50.5% are both above the line, so the expansion is in output and demand. CICC (12 September): production and new orders were the parts that lifted the August industry gauge. A-shares are shut for the holiday, so this print moves no book until trading resumes. The theme changes if the next official manufacturing PMI reprints at or below 50.1%.
themeCards.trigger: The next official manufacturing PMI at or above 50.1%.
themeCards.invalidator: The next official manufacturing PMI at or below 50.1%.

themeCards.title: Micron revenue jumped and the next quarter is guided higher
themeCards.fact: BlockBeats: Micron's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue was 542.29 billion dollars, up from 113.15 billion dollars a year earlier. The company guided the next quarter to about 600 to 630 billion dollars.
themeCards.mechanism: A jump from last year's revenue, with a higher next-quarter guide, says memory demand is still tight. CICC (10 September): AI capital spending is still being financed at longer maturities. US equities carry that demand in the memory complex. The theme changes if the next Micron revenue guide falls back to the prior-year pace of 113.15 billion dollars.
themeCards.trigger: A later Micron revenue guide above 542.29 billion dollars.
themeCards.invalidator: A later Micron revenue guide back at 113.15 billion dollars.
